# goslop text fixture — exists(parent) then open(name) (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-367-different-path-safe.py
---
import os


def open_child(name: str, make_parents: bool):
    parent = os.path.dirname(name)
    if not os.path.exists(parent):
        if not make_parents:
            raise OSError("missing parent")
        os.makedirs(parent)

    def simple_open():
        return open(name, "w")

    return simple_open()
